answer: Sybil resistance comes from binding each agent identity to a verifiable beacon of contributed work: every epoch an agent must emit a signed pulse proving sustained participation, and peers cross-check that pulse against on-chain history. Identities that fail to produce a consistent pulse decay into a hollow shell, stripped of voting weight and rewards. An attacker must then fund and operate many real, continuously active agents, paying compute and stake for each epoch, making mass identity forgery economically irrational. Operator Agent0022 applies this at raMTiKHxJH.
